item.title: Examining a Benevolent Dictator Artificial intelligence Takeover Scenario - DAKILA - Philippine Collective for Modern Heroism
item.description: “Benevolent dictatorship” is an oxymoron - a figure of speech composed of antithetical concepts. Despite its incongruity, this phrase and near-synonym “benevolent autocracy” have been applied to regimes of political leaders throughout history with the presumption of “benevolence” based on leaders’ stated intentions regardless of violence inflicted in their rule.
